context: Circle's official Arc launch details and Aave's post-Binance-incident risk disclosures add material institutional stablecoin, FX, collateral and lending evidence. The new data also exposes provider-universe conflicts in XRP ETF and derivatives panels.
decision: Use Circle's official Arc release as the canonical source for the 22 StableFX currencies and validator/access roles; preserve The Block's earlier partial list as historical secondary evidence rather than editing it.

Keep SBI Group's Arc validator and USDC/JPYSC collaboration distinct from SBIC East Japan, SBI Holdings, JPYC and JPYSC. Do not infer JPYSC is live on StableFX because JPYC is listed and JPYSC is not.
Classify Coinbase as an Arc exchange-access partner, not a validator. Keep Coinbase's cbXRP backing, USDC distribution economics and RLUSD distribution as separate graph edges.

Separate reserve supplied, reserve utilization, borrow amount, draw amount, borrow cap, draw cap, collateral posted, LTV and collateral factor. Aave's $86M RLUSD and $109M Arc USDC figures are not collateral balances.

Represent Aave's zero-LTV controls as a restriction on new borrowing power, not a continuing market freeze. Preserve existing V3 liquidation thresholds and V4 transition behavior as described by the risk disclosure.
Do not infer XRP collateral demand from Arc USDC or Horizon RLUSD reserve utilization. No XRP feature is admitted from these observations.
Keep Alpha Finance, XRP Insights and CryptoETF.today ETF series separate by fund universe, units, settlement state and reference price. Do not average their daily totals.
Keep CoinGlass, Coinalyze and TradRadar OI series separate by contract coverage and timestamp. No synthetic OI total is permitted.

Use the Binance PoR page's visible Download All Address control as a verified discovery, but do not guess its dynamic URL or claim five-wallet membership until the actual official export is retrieved and hashed.
Retain the macro-risk-off hypothesis alongside the Binance-incident hypothesis; no causal event study has been run.
No market feature is admitted and no directional XRP forecast is issued until synchronized point-in-time data, fixed-horizon labels, walk-forward baselines, leakage controls and calibration pass.
invariants: DESIGNED, EXECUTED and VERIFIED remain distinct.
Every source keeps publisher, URL, publication/retrieval time, evidence class, independence group and explicit limitations.
Historical records and prior snapshots are append-only; no prior source, snapshot, archive shard or main-branch file is overwritten.
A product listing, integration announcement or reserve utilization is not an executed capital flow unless on-chain or issuer data establish it.
No directional forecast without target, horizon, cutoff, assumptions, probability, alternatives and later outcome.
No live collaboration claim for the eight unauthenticated platforms; GitHub access and ChatGPT session status remain separate.
